message: We run a gym and our admin is all over the place. We need something to manage members, classes, and operations more smoothly.
Who are the different users or roles that will use this system?

We've got the front desk staff handling check-ins, the coaches running classes, and me and my partner managing the memberships, billing, and the overall business side. Everyone needs different levels of access, especially since I don't want front desk staff messing with billing details or member contracts.
Do you operate from a single location or multiple locations or branches?

Just one location right now, though we've talked about opening a second spot eventually if things keep growing. For now, everything happens under one roof, but I definitely need the system to keep things running smoothly here without adding to our admin load.
How do you currently track your inventory, records, or data, and what problems come up?

Right now it's a total mess of Google Sheets, paper signup forms, and a notebook we keep behind the front desk. People sign up or change their minds about classes, and half the time it doesn't get updated properly, which leads to awkward moments at the door and missed payments. During peak hours in the evening, the front desk gets swamped trying to check people in manually while new folks are waiting to join.
Walk me through what happens in your core daily workflow from start to finish.

Doors open early with the morning crew scanning in, and whoever is at the front desk has to frantically cross-reference our messy spreadsheet to make sure people's dues are actually paid up. Once that morning rush clears, coaches start showing up for their classes and usually ask who's booked in, which means checking another sheet or just guessing based on who walks through the door. Throughout the day we're dealing with drop-ins, people trying to freeze or cancel their memberships over email, and manually processing payments that inevitably fail or get missed. By the time the evening rush hits, it's absolute chaos at the front desk with check-ins, new signups on paper forms, and people asking about class spots, leaving us to sort out the paperwork and fix the spreadsheet errors late at night.
How do payments or transactions get handled and reconciled today?

Honestly, it's pretty painful right now. We take credit cards manually through a basic terminal at the desk, and for the automatic monthly dues, we've been trying to track them on our spreadsheet, which means payments fail all the time and we only find out days later when someone's card gets declined at the door. At the end of the day, we just match up whatever receipts printed out from the terminal with whatever notes we scribbled down, and hope the numbers match up.
What reporting or visibility do you need across the business?

I just need to know at a glance who's actually paid, who's falling behind on their dues, and how many people are showing up to classes so we know if we need to add another session. At the end of the month, I want a quick, clean summary of total revenue and active members without having to dig through a dozen different tabs.
What other tools or systems does this need to work with?

We don't use much right now besides that basic credit card terminal at the front desk, so it would be great if whatever you build can hook right into that or handle payments directly so we don't have to juggle separate devices. Other than that, we just use standard email for reaching out to members, so nothing too complicated.
